description: This file implements the ApplicationManagementServer class, which manages IPC communication for application management in the Rialto server. It handles initialization, event sending, starting/stopping the server thread, and client disconnection handling.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Manages IPC server for application management, including client connections, event notifications, and server thread control.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket, sets up client connection and exports the service.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the connected client, converting internal session state to external representation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread that processes incoming IPC requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the IPC client connection if connected.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, logging the disconnection.
